text: Brand and product name clearly visible.
look: Look at the PDP: is the brand and product name legible at print size?

text: Statement of identity (“Dietary Supplement”) present and prominently displayed.
look: Per the Enova guideline the statement of identity must appear in a size reasonably similar to the largest print on the panel. Compare it on the artwork.

text: Net quantity of contents correct in value and unit of measure.
Net quantity of contents in correct location.
look: Per the Enova guideline the net quantity must sit in the bottom third of the PDP. Check its position on the artwork.

text: SFP located to the immediate right of the PDP.
look: Check the SFP sits immediately to the right of the PDP.

text: Font is correct size and type.
look: Type size is measured from the artwork; the typeface is not. Confirm the face and weight match the approved panel.

text: “Supplement Facts” title bold and full width of the panel.
look: Check the “Supplement Facts” title is bold and runs the full width of the panel.

text: Serving Size correct value and unit of measure.
Servings per container accurate according to MF and net quantity of contents.
Hairlines used to separate nutrients and ingredients. Hairlines span the entire width of the panel.
look: Check every hairline spans the entire width of the panel and none stops short.

text: Bold hairlines used where required.
look: Check the bold hairlines are present where the format requires them.

text: Nutrients listed in the correct order.
Nutrients are properly declared.
Nutrient quantities properly declared and match values in MF.
look: Compare every amount per serving against the Master Formula. The label cannot prove this to itself.

text: Nutrient unit of measure correct.
Nutrients are declared above minimum reportable quantities and presented in appropriate increment units.
Nutrient Percent Daily Values are provided and accurate.
Proprietary blends are listed and formatted correctly.
Proprietary blends amount per serving correct and % DV properly footnoted.
Dietary ingredients listed correctly with correct amount per serving and % DV properly footnoted.
Botanical extracts are properly referenced.
Other ingredients are accurate with the MF and ingredients are listed in descending concentration.
look: Compare the Other Ingredients declaration against the Master Formula, including descending order of concentration.

text: Other ingredients are declared immediately following the SFP.
look: Check the Other Ingredients declaration falls immediately below the SFP.

text: Ingredients that are used as preservatives and those use as colorants are properly identified.
If the product contains an allergen, it is properly declared.
The allergen statement, if required, immediately follows the ingredient declaration.
look: Check the allergen statement falls immediately after the ingredient declaration.

text: Distributor statement is present and contains a physical street address. Company email, website, and phone number are optional.
The distributor statement immediately follows the ingredient declaration or the allergen statement.
look: Check the distributor statement follows the ingredient or allergen declaration — not, for example, tucked under the barcode.

text: Suggested use is present and appropriate for the product.
The amount provided in the suggested use is consistent with the amount per serving of the SFP.
Mandatory warnings are present and appropriate where applicable (e.g., for iron: accidental overdose warning).
General cautions (e.g. pregnancy, keep out of reach of children, consult a physician, storage requirements. etc.) are present and appropriate where applicable.
FDA warning is present, accurate and enclosed in a box border.
look: The wording can be checked from the copy; the box border cannot. Confirm the disclaimer is enclosed in a box on the artwork.

text: Structure/Function Claims are truthful, appropriate, non-misleading, and substantiated.
look: Confirm each structure/function claim is covered by substantiation held on file, and that FDA notification was made within 30 days of first marketing.

text: Qualified Health Claims are properly qualified and appropriate.
Certifications are properly declared (proper logo, placement, etc.).
look: Check each certification mark is the correct logo, correctly placed, and that the certification is current.

text: Trademarked ingredients are declared and referenced as required by TMLA.
look: Check the trademark licence agreement for each branded ingredient and confirm the reference on the label matches the wording the agreement requires.

text: UPC code is present where applicable and properly formatted.
No intervening or overlapping material between required elements.
look: Check nothing overlaps or intervenes between the required elements at print size.

text: Language is appropriate with accurate spelling and grammar.
look: Read the artwork for spelling and grammar. OCR substitutes letters, so a reading of the copy cannot settle this.

text: Label revision is present on the bottom of the left side panel.
look: Check the revision code is printed on the bottom of the LEFT side panel, in the Enova format (Rev. # - MM/YY).
